long.title: Who Ate the Birthday Cake? 🎂🔍 Cartoon Cars Mystery
long.description:
It's Big Bertha's birthday, but the strawberry cake disappears the moment everyone closes their eyes! Inspector Bolt puts every car on the Truth Press, follows the pink frosting tracks and learns that sorry is a small word that fixes big things. Inspector Bolt #2

#kids #cartoon #cars

s1.title: The Birthday Cake Just VANISHED! 🎂😱 #shorts
s1.description: Everyone closed their eyes for one second... and Big Bertha's birthday cake was gone! Full episode on the Inspector Bolt channel.

s2.title: Turbo's Secret Birthday Present?! 🍌 #shorts
